shared_elements: large bird/raptor with wing rendered as parallel incised lines (hatched feathers)
small human-like figure with arms bent and hands shown
animal head in profile with prominent round eye and beak/snout
vertically stacked registers of creatures on a tall upright form
human figure positioned beneath/adjacent to the bird
schematic quadruped/animal bodies in low relief
justification: Both show a large raptor-like bird whose wing is conveyed by a fan of parallel incised feather-lines, placed above/over a small schematic human figure with bent arms and splayed hands, and both stack their creatures in vertical tiers on a tall upright form with prominent staring eyes and heavy schematic heads. The main difference is that A spreads several distinct animals (quadrupeds in a row, a hatched band, waterbird, snake-like elements) across a flat panel in relief registers, while B compresses only the bird and the crouching human into a single three-dimensional stacked group without the accompanying animal rows or ornamental band.
